When it is your pick in the draft, the player ranked highest at the next position in this table will be drafted. To add a position, press the + button, and then select the position desired.
positionRankHelp.title: Positions

pageHelp.text:
Use this screen to rank your players in order of how you want them to be drafted for the Automated Draft or Live Online Draft. All actions are saved automatically, so there is no "Save" button. When it is your pick in the draft, the top ranked player in the Rankings table will be drafted for you. The next player in the list will then be drafted on your next pick, and so forth. You can add players to your Rankings table by clicking on the green ?+" icon next to the player's name. You may transfer over any # of players (including none at all) to Rankings. If there are no players remaining in that list, Fantrax will draft players for your team from the Fantrax Rankings table, in the order that they appear. Please note that only players eligible to play in this league will be shown.

The Exclude List is for players you do not want to be drafted at any point in the draft. You can move players here by clicking on the red icon next to the player's name in the Fantrax Rankings.

By using the Position table, you are able to refine your draft by choosing which positions you want drafted, and in what order. When it is your pick in the draft, the player ranked highest at the next position in this table will be drafted. Please note that the Position Rankings supersede any Player Rankings. If, in a football league for example, you have the Kicker position ranked first, a kicker will be drafted for you in Round 1, regardless of where you may have any players ranked. Please be extremely careful if using position rankings. To add a position, press the ?+ Add Position" button, and then select the position desired. You may add as many as you like. When it is your pick in the draft, Fantrax will draft a player, based on the other tables (see above), that plays the position at the top of your Position list, and will continue down the list for every subsequent pick.

Also note that under the 3-dot menu at the right, you have some other filtering options, as well as the ability to import rankings from a spreadhseet, copy rankings from another league, and clear your rankings.

AUTO-DRAFT ORDER
This option determines how the system will auto-draft for your team as follows, after any players in your queue as well as your pre-ranked players (those you may have ranked in the RANK PLAYERS screen):

"Fpts" (points-based leagues) or "Score" (rotisserie leagues)
The system will use seasonal projections (or last year's stats) and your league's scoring system to determine the ranking.

ADP
The system will use the the site-wide ADP (Average Draft Position). The ADP option is only available if there is enough ADP data available. If you do not see this option, it may not be close enough to the start of the season, or it may not be supported by the sport of this league.

Other Rankings
Depending on the sport and availability, you may see other rankings provided by Fantrax or third-parties, which you may use. These are "fixed" rankings, in that they are not tied to your scoring system.
